reviewed_by: Claude Code, building the approved Butler mode mockup (Figma page 162:2) on 2026-11-20
reason: Butler mode adds a full-screen /butler view: a Core-owned status board of every non-archived project's chats (new API-worker read GET /api/v1/butler/board: waiting, working, recently failed and counted idle chats, with attention summaries, goals, idle paging and ETags) beside parallel Butler threads (ButlerSessionReservation gains thread/title: each thread is its own Butler session marked butler_thread with an operator-owned title, excluded from the panel's current-Butler lookup; GET /api/v1/butler/threads lists them across projects with state). The UI page groups cards by attention or project, expands a card to its goal and pending approval (Approve, Deny, Stop, Open chat, Ask Butler about this), starts threads in the chosen or card's project and streams several at once; the Butler panel header opens it. Selected: the global project-read suite (board and threads on SQLite here, PostgreSQL in the local run), Butler session reservation, the settings catalog destination, product-help discovery and digest, the knowledge-index digest sync, the impact-catalog checks for the new area, the new board/thread unit tests, the Butler panel component suite, and the new real-Core LAN journey in all eight assistant-real profiles.
exclusions: Pre-existing reds on main are not selected: tests/v3/test_butler_workflow_registry.py (2 unreviewed holdProjectView/releaseProjectView signatures, unchanged by this PR; npm run build's registry guard still checks every new call), tests/test_playwright_impact.py::test_full_manifest_covers_every_product_browser_spec_without_filters (ios-shell-real-core.spec.ts is uncatalogued on main; butler-mode.spec.ts is catalogued here), and tests/v3/test_product_knowledge.py::test_product_search_finds_headless_core_and_paired_butler_cli. The knowledge LAN bootstrap case needs a host LAN fixture and is covered by the digest-sync case. PostgreSQL variants of the board/threads tests skip without NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL in CI; they passed locally against PostgreSQL 16. No native code changed.
